resources.string: Learn a language while you scroll. Live translated captions over TikTok, Reels and Shorts that work with AirPods and headphones, and everything stays on your phone.
Instant: words appear as they\'re spoken (recommended)
Checking whether instant captions work on this phone…
Each language downloads once, now, so nothing downloads while you\'re scrolling. With more than one, the app works out each video\'s language for you.
Their translations download now, once. Other languages still work: they show in their own words until their translation has downloaded.
Any language: works it out for you (a few seconds behind)
Basic: one language (if Instant isn\'t available)
“Any language” can\'t run on this phone.
More accurate needs a faster phone. Automatic picks the best your phone can keep up with.

1. Choose how to listen and tick the languages you watch.
2. Choose the language to translate into.
3. Tap Start captions. The first time, allow “Display over other apps” and the sound permission. Android calls it Microphone, but only your phone's own sound is used.
4. When asked what to share, choose “A single app” and pick TikTok (or the app you're watching). Your notifications stay visible.
5. Captions appear over your videos and clear when you swipe. Drag the box to move it, or tap ✕ to stop.
Learn a language while you scroll.
An example: a Spanish video with its English caption.
Where\'s the best beach around here?
¿Dónde está la mejor playa por aquí?
Works out the language for you, a few seconds behind.
One language, if Instant isn\'t available.
Nothing is recorded or uploaded. Clear speech works best; loud music under the voice makes captions less accurate.
